command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
uname -r
if getent passwd appworker; then id appworker; else printf 'appworker=absent\n'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- existing limits entries ---'
grep -RnsE '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]' /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true

grep -Hn 'pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d/common-session /etc/pam.d/common-session-noninteractive /etc/pam.d/sshd 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- health ---'
systemctl is-system-running || true
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager || true
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /

command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd appworker >/dev/null; then
  useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker
fi
umask 022
printf '%s\n' '# Managed account limits for appworker login sessions' 'appworker soft nofile 8192' 'appworker hard nofile 8192' 'appworker soft nproc 256' 'appworker hard nproc 256' > /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
getent passwd appworker
id appworker
stat -c 'home=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a' /home/appworker
stat -c 'limits=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a' /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
cat /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf

command:

printf 'pam_login_limits=verified\n'
